about: src/lib/dawam_vectors.json is a byte-for-byte copy of madar-shared's file at this tag (the backend runs the same rules from madar-dawam). A change is made there, released with a tag, and copied here with the tag and hash below updated; scripts/check-shared-vectors.sh (CI) and shared_vectors.test.ts check it, and features/dawam/pay-period-vectors.test.ts runs the dashboard's pay-period rule against its periods.
